snippet.title: Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones - Opening and Title Screen
snippet.description:
----------
Hi.

It's been a while, huh? I started playing a bunch of Female Only runs in games, and thought this one would be fun to record. Hopefully you'll enjoy it!

I'm thinking of doing voice commentary for this one, but I'll upload voiceless versions for those who want their gameplay to be nothin' but clicks and slashes.
----------

System: Game Boy Advance
Game: Fire Emblem - The Sacred Stones
Playthrough: Female Only, Eirika Route
